text:
olivia: Heads up — noticed a handful of customer invoices where Stripe shows a single prorated charge but NetSuite ends up with two stub lineitems and the invoice total is off. Noticed first on 3/18 during daily recon.
samir: Ugh. Any specific examples/IDs? could be our proration flattening logic + webhook replay edge.
olivia: Example payload: `invoice: inv_1JxABC, customer: cus_9z, amount_due: 12000` Stripe webhook created one line for prorated amount. NetSuite import created two lines: 6000 and 6000, but with different memo text so reconciliation failed.
maya: I saw the same in the late arrivals queue. Affected customers ~7 last 48h. Some were in DLQ and reprocessed.
alejandro: Do we have the raw webhook replay log? fin-bot queued a retry for inv_1JxABC at 2026-03-18T04:21Z — link: https://logs.redwood/stripe/webhook/2109871234
samir: Looking at code: we group prorations by invoice_line id but also apply a fuzzy memo normalization. If memo text differs slightly (e.g., 'proration: plan A' vs 'proration: Plan A') we might treat as distinct lines and split.
odivia: typo: "odivia" should be olivia — ignore
olivia: ^sorry typo
samir: Quick hypothesis: webhook replay combined with a subsequent incremental billing update created two partial lines. We should dedupe on Stripe's `line_item.id` when present and fallback to (amount+proration_period+plan_id) as a composite key.
maya: For urgent mitigation can we re-run the NetSuite reconcile job for those invoices after collapsing duplicates? That should fix totals for reporting.
dave: Finance OK with a small reprocess if it fixes totals. We need a short audit trail: which invoices changed and why. Maya can you list affected invoices and attach to this thread? :eyes:
maya: Will do. Running extractor now, pinging once I have CSV.
fin-bot: Deploy request queued by @samir — PR #4523 (billing: idempotency for stripe lineitems) — status: review required
samir: PR adds a dedupe step before NetSuite upsert + unit tests for capitalization/memo normalization. Also adds telemetry event `billing.lineitem.dedupe_applied`.
alejandro: Can we also add a small backfill job to collapse duplicates created in last 7 days? Should be idempotent.
samir: Yes, I'll add backfill script but need Finance signoff for any write operations to NetSuite.
dave: Signoff granted for backfill limited to invoices in the CSV Maya will provide. Please include rollback notes.
maya: CSV attached: inv_1JxABC, inv_2KzLLL, inv_3Mno99, inv_4Pqr00, inv_5Sst11, inv_6Uvw22, inv_7Xyz33
maya: Quick note: two of these already showed as reconciled in BI with manual adjustments; will flag in CSV.
samir: Plan: 1) Merge PR to add dedupe (no NetSuite writes) + deploy to staging 2) Run backfill on staging and verify diffs 3) After Dave confirms CSV and rollback plan, run limited backfill in Prod for listed invoices 4) Reprocess DLQ for any requeued webhooks
alejandro: I'll prioritize the staging deploy. ETA ~2h.
olivia: Can Billing Ops hold recon reports until after backfill? We don't want duplicate adjustments.
dave: Yes, hold automated reconciles for that set. Finance will pause those entries until confirmed.
maya: After backfill I'll run the reconcile job manually and post checksum and before/after totals.
samir: If anyone sees other patterns (e.g., duplicate when coupon present), add to the CSV. Might be a separate case.
olivia: FYI this surfaced because our daily usage aggregation flagged a mismatch > $0.50 threshold. Might lower threshold later but good catch.
fin-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1420, severity: low -> medium (billing mismatch) — assignees: maya, samir
alejandro: staging deploy done. logs: `billing-service.v3 - dedupe step applied to 7 invoices`.
samir: Backfill script ready, will wait for Dave's explicit go.
dave: Go ahead for the 7 invoices listed. Keep me posted in thread and include NetSuite record ids after run.
maya: Running backfill now on prod for the 7 invoices. ETA ~8 minutes.
maya: Done. NetSuite updates: ns_inv_9001 -> inv_1JxABC collapsed two lines into single line; ns_inv_9002 -> inv_2KzLLL collapsed; others similar. Posting before/after totals CSV.
olivia: I see totals reconciled. Thanks everyone. :tada:
samir: Follow-up: PR merged, will add unit test for memo normalization edge cases tomorrow.
dave: Great job. Please add a short postmortem blurb to the weekly finance notes describing cause and remediation.
maya: Will write the blurb and attach CSVs.
olivia: Closing loop: look into reducing fuzzy memo variance at source (billing library) to avoid future splits.
samir: Noted. Will schedule a small change.
fin-bot: Incident INC-2026-1420 -> resolved by @samir @maya on 2026-03-18T10:12Z
